From: Alex Rivera <alex@praxisai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Quick demo request — signed up & trialing

Hi Vanessa,

I signed up for a trial last week and have been poking around the API — thanks for the great docs. My name is Alex, head of platform at Praxis AI. We're exploring a pilot to replace a portion of our customer support triage workflow with model-assisted routing + short summarization (so a mix of chat+embeddings usage).

Quick context:
- Trial account created 2027-07-28, sample traffic ~12k requests/day (mostly short prompts, avg 450 tokens/request).
- Our initial sandbox tests show acceptable quality; we'll need to validate latency at ~200 concurrent users during business hours.
- Timeline: prefer a 4–8 week pilot, hoping to start a technical pilot in ~6 weeks.

Would love a short 30–45 minute walkthrough to clarify fit and what Dedicated/Private options look like for data controls and throughput. I'm in Eastern time (ET). What slots do you have next week?

Also, if useful, I can attach our security questionnaire.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform, Praxis AI
alex@praxisai.com
+1 (646) 555-0193
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@praxisai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:07:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — signed up & trialing

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I can run a quick intro and scope-check. A few quick questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Primary use case: sound like support triage + summarization. Is the goal automated routing (100% automated) or a human-in-the-loop assistant?
2) Expected steady-state volume beyond pilot (tokens/day or requests/day)? You mentioned 12k/day in trial; what do you expect at pilot peak?
3) Latency SLO: do you need sub-300ms p95 for short completions, or is ~500ms acceptable?
4) Data residency / retention: will customer data need to remain in US only? Any compliance/sensitive data concerns?
5) Attendees: please confirm who from Praxis will join (engineering/infra + product recommended).

Proposed times (ET):
- Tue 8/3 10:00–10:45am ET
- Wed 8/4 2:00–2:45pm ET
- Thu 8/5 3:00–3:45pm ET

I've attached a short pre-demo checklist to speed the convo (see attachment). Ben (cc'd) is on our SDR/ops team and can lock the invite — if none of the above work, tell us 2 slots that do and we'll adapt.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (doc, 120 KB)
From: Alex Rivera <alex@praxisai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:43:55 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — signed up & trialing

Thanks Vanessa — answers inline below.

1) Human-in-the-loop initially: we want to reduce triage load and provide ranked suggestions to agents; full automation may be later.
2) Pilot expected peak: ~60k requests/day (~450 tokens/request mean) — steady-state after pilot could be 200–300k/day depending on results.
3) Latency: aim for p95 <= 400ms for short responses; sub-300ms would be ideal but not a blocker for pilot.
4) Data residency: US-only for pilot; we will have some PII in transcripts so SOC2/audit logs matter. I attached our security questionnaire (redacted) — hope that's helpful.
4b) Timeline: target pilot kickoff in 6 weeks, pilot length 6–8 weeks.
5) Attendees: Me (platform), Priya (engineering manager, priya@praxisai.com) — Priya can join technical deep-dive.

Preferred times: Tue 8/3 10am ET works well. If you can do that, let's lock it.

Attachment: security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 780 KB)

—Alex
